product.title: San Diego Whale Watching Cruise

description.text: Cruise offshore from San Diego to look for gray whales, dolphins, and other marine life with expert narration from the crew. The route combines open-ocean wildlife viewing with scenic harbor departures and seasonal migration opportunities.

highlights: Seasonal whale and dolphin watching in the Pacific.
Large viewing decks for open-water sightseeing.
Good fit for wildlife-focused adventure travelers.

start.description: 2050 Shelter Island Dr, San Diego, CA 92106, USA.
